evidence_claims.claim_text: Frieze Seoul 2026 runs at COEX Halls C and D from 2026-09-02 through 2026-09-05. September 2, 11:00-19:00 is invitation only; September 3 is invitation/preview-ticket access from 11:00-15:00 and public access from 15:00; September 4-5 are open 11:00-19:00.

The live Frieze ticket page says discounted tickets are sold out and full-price tickets remain on sale; its Buy Now path opens the official Govent checkout, where full-price ticket quantities can still be selected.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Buy a currently offered full-price ticket online through the organizer's Govent checkout; discounted inventory is no longer available.
evidence_claims.conflict_notes: Availability differs by price class: discounted inventory is closed, while full-price inventory remains purchasable.

evidence_claims.claim_text: The live official checkout lists KRW 250,000 for a Preview Ticket, KRW 90,000 for General Admission Preview Entry on September 3 or First Access before 15:00 on September 4-5, KRW 70,000 for Afternoon Access after 15:00 on September 4-5, and KRW 55,000 for students aged 7-19 with ID; every ticket permits access to both Frieze Seoul and Kiaf Seoul, with the selected fair visited first except for preview tickets.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Online purchase only; student ticket holders must be aged 7-19 and present ID, and general-admission buyers must enter their selected fair first.

evidence_claims.claim_text: Neighbourhood Nights runs on four consecutive evenings by district: Euljiro on August 31, Hannam on September 1, Cheongdam on September 2 and Samcheong on September 3, with organizer-listed late openings, receptions, performances, talks and parties at participating venues.
COEX's official venue listing calls Frieze Seoul 2026 the fourth edition, while Frieze's organizer-owned About page calls it the fifth edition.
competing_explanations: The COEX listing may have retained the prior edition number in reused event copy.
evidence_claims.conflict_notes: The organizer-owned Frieze page is controlling for edition identity and identifies 2026 as the fifth edition; dates and venue agree across both sources.

chip_support.reason: The organizer explicitly marks discounted tickets sold out while full-price tickets remain on sale.
A single paid ticket provides entry to both Frieze Seoul and Kiaf Seoul under the stated first-entry condition.
The organizer lists receptions, artist talks, performances, parties and late openings across four Seoul districts.

unresolved: Neighbourhood Nights has no single participation or payment path: the organizer supplies venue-by-venue schedules and maps, while access, capacity, RSVP and price conditions must be checked with each participating venue; at least one listed event is explicitly a private viewing.
The ticket shop does not expose remaining numeric inventory for each full-price category before purchase.
COEX has not corrected its fourth-edition wording to match Frieze's fifth-edition identification.

evidence_claims.claim_text: Seoul's official sports portal schedules the 2026 season every Thursday from 2026-04-16 through 2026-10-29, 19:00-21:00, using Gwanghwamun Square, Yeouido Park and Banpo Hangang Park as gathering zones.

Participation is free for Seoul citizens who enjoy exercise, with 40-60 participants per session; the Seoul public-reservation channel allocates 30 first-come places per zone and limits an application to one person.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Apply for one person through Seoul Public Service Reservation when the weekly window opens, or use another organizer-approved channel or limited day-of registration.

evidence_claims.claim_text: Sessions include running-form coaching and pre/post-run stretching; the official plan lists 12 routes across the three zones, from 2.5 km to 10 km.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Join a scheduled session after successful advance registration or accepted day-of registration.

evidence_claims.claim_text: For the next Thursday session on 2026-09-03, the live Yeouido reservation calendar showed 0/30 applications but 'reservation unavailable' because booking opens at 00:00 on 2026-08-31, three days before use; Seoul also permits advance registration through Dongma Club and limited day-of on-site registration.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: For the 2026-09-03 Seoul-reservation allocation, return when booking opens at 2026-08-31 00:00; first-time Seoul Public Service Reservation users need a unified Seoul account and mobile identity verification.

evidence_claims.claim_text: The official Seoul sports portal gives the exact last Thursday as 2026-10-29, while the Seoul Future Hangang Headquarters event wrapper displays 2026-10-31 even though its detail text describes a Thursday-through-October series.
competing_explanations: The Hangang event wrapper may use an administrative display range through the end of October rather than the last actual Thursday session.
evidence_claims.conflict_notes: Use 2026-10-29 as the exact final occurrence because it is the date on the dedicated sports-program schedule and is the last Thursday in the displayed range.

chip_support.reason: The official booking and program pages state that participation is free.
The live channel limits the zone to 30 first-come online places and one applicant per reservation.
The official program provides form coaching, stretching and routes spanning 2.5 km to 10 km across three zones.

unresolved: The exact 2026-09-03 route and pace-group assignment were not yet posted on the inspected booking page; it directs participants to the official 7979_src Instagram for weekly details.
The number of same-day on-site places is not fixed on the official pages and remains subject to session operations.

The Seoul reservation page labels the overall service 'service ended' while simultaneously showing future September Thursday entries and a future opening rule; the per-date opening rule was used for current availability.

subjects.canonical_title: STORY A Seongsu: Beauty Survival Murder Mystery

evidence_claims.claim_text: STORY A's official organizer profile lists the Seongsu run from 2026-07-28 through 2026-10-18 at STORY A on the second floor of Amore Seongsu; the live booking product describes an approximately 70-minute open-format crime-scene escape experience and states that English participation is available.

The handed-off Naver item URL ending in 785624 is closed, but that listing links to the current product ending in 7856242; the replacement product is bookable with immediate confirmation and exposed selectable September dates and times, including multiple sessions on 2026-09-01.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Use the active replacement product at https://m.booking.naver.com/booking/12/bizes/1696844/items/7856242, select an enabled date/time and purchase the required number of participant tickets.
competing_explanations: The original product record may have been retired and replaced without updating the handed-off canonical URL.
evidence_claims.conflict_notes: The old product is genuinely closed, but the experience itself is not closed because the same Naver business listing exposes an active replacement product.

evidence_claims.claim_text: The active booking product lists an opening-special ticket at KRW 15,000 per person, a KRW 12,000 repeat-customer ticket requiring proof of at least two prior experiences, and a KRW 7,500 store-customer ticket requiring a same-day Amore Seongsu purchase of at least KRW 100,000 and limited to two people per receipt; the displayed reference price is KRW 30,000.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Choose the applicable ticket tier and satisfy its proof or same-day purchase condition; otherwise use the KRW 15,000 opening-special ticket.

evidence_claims.claim_text: Naver Booking states that escape-room customers receive a 10% discount coupon for all products at Amore Seongsu.
evidence_claims.acquisition_condition: Book and use the escape-room experience; redemption exclusions or stacking rules were not exposed on the inspected listing.

evidence_claims.claim_text: The booking terms require arrival 10 minutes early and tickets for the actual number of participants, cap one booking at 12 tickets, prohibit cancellation or changes after 17:00 on the preceding day, allow children of any age on weekdays with a guardian, and restrict weekends and public holidays to ages 10 and older regardless of guardian accompaniment.

chip_support.reason: The live booking page gives three concrete discounted price tiers and the exact qualification conditions for the two lower tiers.
The booking listing explicitly grants escape-room users a 10% Amore Seongsu product coupon.
The organizer gives a fixed event end date of 2026-10-18.

unresolved: The active Naver calendar exposed dates only through 2026-09-20 at the observation time, so later inventory through the organizer-stated 2026-10-18 end date had not yet been released or was not visible.

The booking page displayed a separate 20% coupon but did not expose its eligibility, validity period, exclusions or stacking rules without downloading it, so no evidence claim was created for that coupon.
The exact redemption exclusions for the 10% Amore Seongsu product coupon were not exposed on the inspected listing.
